title: Testing and safely rolling out OTA updates

spans.text: Updating one device is simple; updating hundreds at once is risky. A staged rollout updates a test device first, then a small group, and expands only after success.

Before updating, verify the board model, firmware version, file size, and cryptographic signature. Use TLS/HTTPS and validate the server certificate; provision a distinct key or certificate per device. Test power loss, weak Wi-Fi, full storage, incompatible images, and incomplete downloads.

After an update, check that the device boots, sensors respond, readings are plausible, and network connectivity returns. Pause the rollout if failures rise. Keep a path back to a known-good version when possible. Never put passwords or private keys in logs.

spans.code:
1. Test on a spare device.
2. Verify model, version, size, and signature.
3. Update a small test group.
4. Check boot, sensor readings, and connectivity.
5. Pause rollout if failures rise; recover if needed.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Install only images whose signature and compatibility are verified. Check power, storage, and recovery capacity before each update.
